result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with short headline-led sections. Innovation and technology-as-force-for-good dominate, stated with confident "can and will" phrasing, while "striving" and "working to" hedge other commitments. Stakeholders addressed are mainly society and customers; employees appear only in the COVID and diversity passages. Shareholders and governance are absent; the Trustworthy Computing heading has no content.
